entries.826bebc7a4dfcf63: This business provides solutions for scientific computing computers. entries.b04f482830903710: The business develops, manufactures and sells industrial computers built to customers' specified orders. As embedded computers, they are installed in manufacturing equipment, machine tools, measuring and inspection equipment, monitoring and control of infrastructure systems, medical devices, digital signage and other products. The company has an integrated structure covering everything from specification design and prototyping to mass production and post-shipment support, and supports long-term stable supply of products with the same specifications. Manufacturing is carried out at the company's domestic plant in Sosa, Chiba Prefecture. Revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥2,905 million.
